studies.headline: Tricholaema leucomelas changes direction depending on which five years of the second atlas are used, so this project reports no change for it.
studies.detail: Against 2008-2012 the change is -0.049; against 2019-2023 it is +0.008. The method note fixed in advance that a species which flips sign between the two windows carries no result.
studies.caveat: Two atlases thirty years apart, so this is a before and after and not a trend: nothing here is per decade. South Africa, Lesotho and Eswatini only, and only where volunteers atlassed twice. Nothing here says why.
